name: PdxMenu
description:
A menu drawn in place from a list of items, with checkbox and radio items, submenus and keyboard
navigation, shown while it is open.
generics: T extends { key?: string; label?: string; type?: string }

members.name: menuId
members.description: The id of the element that is `role="menu"`, for a trigger's `aria-controls`.

members.name: menuClass
members.description:
Classes added to the element that is `role="menu"`: the dropdown's panel is that element,
and `.pdx-dropdown-menu-panel` is what apps and the certification select it by.

members.name: renderItem
members.description:
Draws one entry, as the `item` slot does: `({ item, key, type }) => Node`. For a menu built
from script — `pdx-dropdown-menu` hands its own `item` slot on through it.

members.name: close
members.description: Close the submenu and the menu.

members.name: closeSubmenu
members.description: Close only the open submenu, leaving the menu itself open.

events.name: pdx-select
events.description: Fired when an item is selected.

events.name: pdx-check
events.detail: { key: string; checked: boolean; radioGroup?: string; item: MenuItem }

events.name: open-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `open`. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: menuid
attributes.description: The id of the element that is `role="menu"`, for a trigger's `aria-controls`.

attributes.name: menuclass
attributes.description:
Classes added to the element that is `role="menu"`: the dropdown's panel is that element,
and `.pdx-dropdown-menu-panel` is what apps and the certification select it by.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Renders one menu entry: a snippet `item(item)`.
slots.signature: (item: Exclude<T | (T extends { children?: readonly (infer C)[] } ? C | (C extends { children?: readonly (infer D)[] } ? D : never) : never), { type: 'separator' | 'label' | 'submenu' }>)
